quality.a11y.summary: The tablist has aria-label 'Case detail', tabs report aria-selected correctly with roving tabindex, arrow keys move focus and Enter activates the tab, and the pivot table has col/row th scopes and an aria-label. However, the role=tabpanel (SettlementCaseTabs.tsx:52) has no accessible name. Tabs have no id and no aria-controls, and the panel has no aria-labelledby. The focus indicator is only a low-contrast MUI ripple (outline none). The pivot table's top-left header cell is empty.
